summary: The durable core of dashboard design (IA, visual system, accessibility, content-driven distinctiveness) holds up under adversarial review; three specific claims (pie-vs-bar for proportion estimation, skeleton screens over spinners, chart-agnostic Y-axis-truncation rule) were disproven as originally stated and narrowed rather than reversed, and two 2023-2026 trend claims (glassmorphism's FPS cost, bento grids at high density) remain genuinely unresolved. No claim was found simply false.
